## What changed

Describe the resource, category, documentation, or maintenance change.

## Why it belongs

Explain what we can learn and where it fits in the workflow. For a replacement or removal, explain the evidence behind the decision.

## Resource checks

- [ ] I opened every new or changed resource link.
- [ ] I reviewed the learning material, examples, or documentation.
- [ ] I checked for duplicate coverage.
- [ ] Access, hands-on status, and maintenance notes are accurate.
- [ ] I disclosed any affiliation below.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_resources.py` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_readme.py --check` passes after generation.

## Affiliation

State any affiliation with a suggested resource. Write `No affiliation` when none exists.
